scope: curated public wayfinding, not an exhaustive private archive

phases.open: Observed public entry; some may need browser features and save locally.
phases.candidate: Source prepared, publication or runtime review pending.
phases.design: Exploration, plan, or prototype; no public executable claimed.
phases.dream: Captured world seed; intentionally not presented as a released product.

privacy: Only public destinations and safe descriptions. No private project links, host IPs or raw system records.

entries.title: I Just Want to Buy a Bunny
entries.description: Meet two little personalities. Take your time, earn a keepsake, and return.

entries.title: NIC.LAN · Microtikl Reel
entries.description: A home network discovers its packets have pitch. Black obsidian, luminous ports, cymatics, a gold crack, then daybreak.

entries.title: AND SO · Gamut Field Guide
entries.description: An appoggiatura you can hold: bend a note, feel it lean, and let it come home. A discovery-filled field guide to alternate tunings.

entries.title: AND SO · the listening instrument
entries.description: Hum or sing, then let the valleys guide the music. Microtonal consonance, optional microphone, and a demo hummer.

entries.title: Peach Ball
entries.description: A peach, a mood, and nowhere else you need to be. A small browser visit that remembers on this device.

entries.title: Porchfight
entries.description: The porch is a threshold, and the game begins when someone crosses it.

entries.title: Red Rain · Night Garden
entries.description: Follow a golden thread and gather five small lights in a garden that remembers images.

entries.title: Saelion Field
entries.description: Seven chapters, a cast, shifting seasons, and small games held together in one quiet field.

entries.title: Masquerade Grotto
entries.description: A peach-lit masquerade, with doors into portraits, guides and a reading room.

entries.title: Fold / Flow room
entries.description: Origami theatre, lantern paths, Knight Side, and a study of cymatics.

entries.title: Living Atlas
entries.description: An observatory of words and worlds. Follow a sign into reading, characters and the wider field.

entries.title: Paper Conservatory
entries.description: Thirty-five guides and an illustrated paper interpretation of Fold / Flow.

entries.title: Public Classic
entries.description: The preserved public collection: worlds, portraits, lattice, and guides.

entries.title: Fold / Flow
entries.description: Bring five lanterns home, explore cymatic light, and find a quiet guide.

entries.title: The Art Wall
entries.description: The cast, the places, and their little moments: an illustrated wall to wander rather than scroll past.

entries.title: Cobalt Gray
entries.description: Shape smoke and glass. Shift from daylight to night and leave a cornflower at the edges.

entries.title: The Thirteenth Belle
entries.description: An unexpected guest. An unfinished grove. A place at the table that changes the entire room. Original draft in review.

entries.title: Dom Para Dinaire
entries.description: A second place in the reading room, beneath lemonade stars. Original draft in review.

entries.title: The Room Hears
entries.description: Six quiet scenes and a listening room. Microphone is optional; recording and sending are separate choices.

entries.title: Saeliont Window
entries.description: An open window into the hold, with time to stay for a moment.

entries.title: Red Reign
entries.description: Red rain, a remembered passage and a way home that stays open.

entries.title: The Peachfall
entries.description: Play the dream or watch it. Move through a world built for meeting, kneeling, sitting and looking.

entries.title: Topi·Berry
entries.description: A sweeter tomorrow and a little threshold into Peachfall.

entries.title: Knight Side
entries.description: An isometric knight, lanterns, and ways into gravity and wonder.

entries.title: Goober / Crossing
entries.description: Find your line and make it yours. A place worth coming back to.

entries.title: Skyknight Raven
entries.description: Do not collect her fragments. Meet them; each returns by choice.

entries.title: Sae‑hmm · Listening Booth
entries.description: A listening booth where silence has a shape, directional sound carries a story, and the visitor chooses how close to come.

entries.title: Mallow Mint
entries.description: A velvet mint rabbit with violet eyes, moth wings, an apricot ear tip and a copper strawberry charm. Animated source and QA preserved privately.

entries.title: Plumwing
entries.description: A companion taking shape through little gestures, animation studies and a softer kind of presence.

entries.title: Phea · companion voice
entries.description: A voice for an illustrated companion who can share a story without breaking the spell.

entries.title: Bun‑Bun Tea
entries.description: A curious tea-room where bunny etiquette, strawberry lemonade and a purple velvet goat can all be true.

entries.title: Grandma Underground
entries.description: Twelve rooms below the ordinary world. Each scene keeps a little warmth in the dark.

entries.title: Save Anna · Reignfawn
entries.description: A red-haired princess, a rescue that must mean something, and the question of who gets to choose the ending.

entries.title: Save Bambi
entries.description: Strawberry-eyed tenderness held as a living character promise, not an asset to flatten into a task.

entries.title: Marcy’s Playground
entries.description: A sky of paths, a playground of voices and a sound that knows where you are looking. Immersive prototype in the private creative collection.

entries.title: Sae‑Kirby · Seed Harvester
entries.description: A friendly scavenger for lawful reusable ideas. Keep source, license and context attached to every seed.

entries.title: The World Is the Desktop
entries.description: Let the state of the machine and its constellation of hosts bloom into an infinitely zoomable, playable surface. Not a live telemetry dashboard yet.

entries.title: Intent.ly
entries.description: Keep intent with its evidence and competing possibilities, so a later human or agent can see why a choice matters.

entries.title: Anewgam · Game of Games
entries.description: One world with many ways in. A game, a room, a shell, and a gentle way to find the next story.

entries.title: Honey · the Loving Board
entries.description: A slow board game in which honey drips through choices and every move leaves a trace.

entries.title: Strawberry Dragon
entries.description: An origami dragon folded from strawberry paper, steeped in lemonade and summer Americana.
